name: vishar-crm
description: Operate Vishar CRM through the signed-in user's bounded CRM permissions and Artist context.

interface.shortDescription: Work with Vishar CRM data and approved actions.
interface.longDescription: Read and manage Vishar CRM using the permissions of the signed-in human and the active Artist context. Supports clients, enquiries, projects, scheduling, communications, billing, automations, integrations, notifications, team and workspace operations through a bounded MCP server.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show me what needs my attention in Vishar CRM today.
